001: Good morning, I'm feeling really unwell, I need a doctor.
Good morning, can you tell me what you're feeling?
I have a strong headache and a slight fever.
I see. You can wait here, the doctor will see you soon.
Thank you so much, I'll wait sitting down then.
Make yourself comfortable, just call me if you need anything.
002: Where is the nearest pharmacy from here?
There's one two blocks away, near the bank.
Do you know what time it stays open until?
I think it closes at ten at night, but it's better to confirm.
Perfect, thank you so much for the information.
You're welcome, I hope you feel better soon.
003: Doctor, how many hours apart should this medicine be taken?
You'll take one pill every eight hours, for seven days.
Can I take it with food or does it need to be on an empty stomach?
The ideal is to take it after lunch and after dinner, to avoid stomach irritation.
I see, thank you so much for the guidance.
If the symptoms don't improve, come back here so we can reassess.
004: Sir, do you have any medicine for allergies? I can't stop sneezing.
We have a few options, but first I need to know if you've used any before.
I've used an antihistamine before, but I don't remember the name now.
No problem, I'll show you the options we have here.
Which one of these do you recommend for my case?
This one here is very effective and doesn't make you very sleepy, it's a good choice.
005: I need to get a blood test done, how do I schedule it?
You can schedule it through the app or right here at the front desk.
Do I need to fast for this test?
Yes, you need to go at least eight hours without eating.
How long does it take for the results to come out?
In general, they come out within two business days on the patient portal.
006: My son has had a high fever since last night.
How old is he and what temperature did you measure?
He's four years old and the fever reached thirty-nine degrees.
Have you given him any medicine to bring the fever down?
I gave him a fever reducer, but the fever came back after a few hours.
The ideal is to bring him to the pediatric emergency room for an evaluation.
007: Can you explain to me how to use this ointment?
Of course, you'll apply a thin layer to the affected area, twice a day.
Do I need a prescription to buy this medicine?
Yes, this is a controlled medication, so we only sell it with a prescription.
I see, so I'll go to the doctor first to get the prescription.
That's right, it's important to follow the doctor's instructions properly.
008: I have a pain in my knee that hasn't gone away for a week.
Did you have a fall or do any physical exertion recently?
No, the pain started out of nowhere, with no apparent reason.
I'm going to order an x-ray to check if there's anything more serious.
Okay, doctor, and does it hurt during the exam?
No, it's a quick and painless exam, you can relax.
009: Sir, do you have anything for a sore throat?
We have lozenges and sprays, which one do you prefer?
I think the spray is more practical, which one do you recommend?
This one here is very good, it relieves quickly and has a pleasant taste.
Perfect, I'll take this one then. How much is it?
It comes to twenty-five reais, you can pay at the register.
010: I need to renew my prescription for a medication I take continuously.
Do you have the previous prescription with you? We need to check.
Yes, I do, here it is. I need three more boxes.
Perfect, I'll check if we have them in stock for you.
If you don't, can you order them?
Yes, we can, but it would take one business day to arrive.
